# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this repository, please do **not** open a public GitHub issue.

Instead, contact the maintainer directly through GitHub by sending a private message or using GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability) feature.

Please include:
- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Potential impact

You can expect an acknowledgement within 72 hours and a resolution plan within 7 days.

## Scope

This repository hosts a static website. The primary concerns are:
- Malicious changes to site content
- Introduction of external scripts or resources not approved by the maintainer
- Defacement or unauthorized modifications

## Supported Versions

Only the `main` branch is considered the production version of this site.
